shopify.//outbound_model: DTC 3PL outbound fit from Apr–Jun 2026 tpl_cost_detail invoices (Mar partial and Aug order-fee qty excluded). $2.00 order fee + $6.00 average postage + $0.30 packaging + $0.50 per pick (≈ per unit on this catalog). est_outbound_ship = 8.30 + 0.50 × units_in_order. Flat $9.90/order when units are unknown. Storage and account management stay out of the per-order estimate.

spapi.//orders_report_max_age_years: GET_FLAT_FILE_ALL_ORDERS_* purchase-date floor. Chunks older than this come back DONE with 0 rows. Jan–Jul 2024 is past this wall as of 2026-08; do not poll them.
spapi.//inventory_ledger_days: Daily inventory-ledger window. Physical nexus depends on this feed, so the window is wider than strictly needed: Amazon can restate ledger rows for several days, and a wider window re-upserts them rather than missing them. Upsert-only — a narrow or wide window never deletes older events.
spapi.//inventory_ledger_backfill_days: Weekly deeper re-pull, for ledger rows Amazon settled after the daily window had moved on. Also upsert-only.
spapi.//reimbursements_days: Nightly GET_FBA_REIMBURSEMENTS_DATA window. A 30d window drops July approvals by late August. Chunked to max_chunk_days.
spapi.//case_queue_days: Needs-case queue window. GET_LEDGER_DETAIL_VIEW_DATA eventType=Adjustments (not the deprecated GET_FBA_FULFILLMENT_INVENTORY_ADJUSTMENTS_DATA) plus inbound shipped-vs-received. Chunked to max_chunk_days. Paid GET_FBA_REIMBURSEMENTS_DATA is dedupe only — never the Eligible source.

ads.//lock_ttl_hours: Auto-fail ads pull job_runs still running this long when the PID/heartbeat lease is dead. A live heartbeat keeps a long SB/SD pull from being failed. job_runs.status=running is not the lock.
ads.//lock_heartbeat_stale_minutes: Lease is dead when the lock-file heartbeat is older than this. A dead PID fails immediately even under TTL.
ads.//sku_economics_min_date: Seller Central SKU Economics exports only retain from this month. Earlier ad months need Ads Console campaign CSV or another source — not SKU Economics.
ads.//campaign_chunk_days: SP campaign pull uses 7-day chunks, not one 30-day report. Still clamped to max_chunk_days.
ads.//campaign_sb_sd_chunk_days: SB/SD use 1-day chunks. A single 7-day SB/SD report that timed out used to wipe the whole window (2026-08-25: SB+SD $0, SP kept → Aug 23–24 SP-only vs console). One-day chunks keep prior days when one report stalls. Even 1-day SB/SD can sit PENDING past 15m on this account — poll wait is campaign_report_timeout_{sb,sd}_seconds (1800, same headroom as SP).
ads.//campaign_sb_sd_daily_days: Nightly SB/SD window. Nightly SP uses the same 7d range (ads_campaigns_sync days=7). After a partial, ads-heal retries SB/SD only.
ads.//campaign_sb_sd_backfill_days: Sunday 90d backfill still covers SP for long trends. SB/SD stay on a short window so 03:00 cannot still hold the lock at 05:00.

telegram._doc: Sales-tax / Dashboard Telegram = important updates ONLY. Silent when nothing on the allowlist. Deny wins. src/alerts/telegram_gate.py is the only reader.
